floor_history.headline: Re-confirmed the banked floor-6 candidate (fixed a D_800A35DC type conflict), classed the residual (2 source-level + 2 operand-only real hunks, 26 masked), and killed 3 natural respellings of the sele

De-smelled the selection_sound block to an honest same-variable form (score 6 unchanged); named the GCC branchless-fold mechanism that kills all isolated-test-variable spellings; identified hunk 9's j

Permuter modality: built a working workaround for import.py's broken full-TU workspace on text1b.c, ran a 21,884-iteration campaign, found no improvement on the hunks 17-19 selection_sound register-se

frontier.hypothesis: Hunk 9's jtbl_80015A0C table-offset residual closes once the hand-transcribed jtbl_80015A0C array is deleted from src/text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same change that lands func_800747D8's real switch as committed C, mirroring the already-executed func_8006B578/jtbl_80015988 precedent.
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 emits a switch's ADDR_VEC into the .rodata of the TU containing the switch (build/src/text1b.o); with the hand array still present in text1a_b_mid_rodata.c, the two tables coexist and the sandbox's isolated single-function build sees a placement/offset conflict rather than the real target layout.
frontier.next_probe: At final-submission assembly time (not a src/text1b.c-only session): delete the jtbl_80015A0C array from text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same commit as func_800747D8's C body, then re-measure with sandbox --disable all --diff to confirm hunk 9 closes with zero bb2.ld edits, exactly as it did for func_8006B578.

frontier.hypothesis: Hunk 17's register-seat residual (target lbu v0 vs ours lbu a0) may resolve automatically once hunk 9's table-placement issue is fixed and the switch's real ADDR_VEC is in place, since the current a0-vs-v0 split may be entangled with the same block's surrounding dispatch shape.
frontier.mechanism: unconfirmed -- register allocation for this load may shift once the surrounding switch dispatch is compiled from real C rather than scored against a stand-in hand array
frontier.next_probe: Re-run sandbox --disable all --diff on the same-variable candidate AFTER the text1a_b_mid_rodata.c migration lands, before spending another session on register-seat levers for hunk 17 in isolation.

frontier.hypothesis: The local C-spelling space for hunks 17-19 (selection_sound block) is exhausted by both hand-written and permuter search on this chassis; further sessions in permuter/structural modality on this exact block are unlikely to find new ground without a different mechanism (e.g. RA/scheduler solver classification of the v0-vs-a0 seat).
frontier.mechanism: combine.c's isolated-test-variable branchless fold (documented s2) plus the s3 permuter's independent 21.8k-iteration confirmation that no mutation pass reaches a different byte-identical-count spelling
frontier.next_probe: If a future session revisits this residual, run tools/ra_solver's inverse_compose.py classify on hunk 17 to determine whether the v0-vs-a0 seat is RA- or scheduler-owned before proposing any further hand-written C variant.
